{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to numeric: remove commas and cast to float
df['revenue_numeric'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter only completed orders
df_completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = df_completed[df_completed['revenue_numeric'] == 999999.99]

# Remove QA orders for accurate mean
df_clean = df_completed[df_completed['revenue_numeric'] != 999999.99]

# Compute final mean revenue of completed orders (excluding QA)
mean_revenue_final = df_clean['revenue_numeric'].mean()

# Print key outputs
print(f'Number of completed orders after removing QA: {len(df_clean)}')
print(f'Mean revenue: {mean_revenue_final}')"}
